req.title: Task id is auto-generated
req.statement: The system shall assign a unique integer id to each new task; client-supplied ids in the payload shall be ignored.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should auto-generate a unique integer ID for each new task, ignoring any client-supplied IDs. This behavior needs to be validated through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_create_task_auto_id_positive
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid task payload without an ID.
expected: The response payload contains a unique integer ID for the new task.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "New Task", "description": "Test task description", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert isinstance(response_data["id"], int)
assert response_data["title"] == "New Task"
assert response_data["description"] == "Test task description"
assert response_data["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_create_task_with_invalid_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a payload having an empty title.
expected: The response contains a validation error for the title field.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "", "description": "Invalid task", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "title" in response.json()["detail"][0]["loc"]
assert response.json()["detail"][0]["msg"] == "ensure this value has at least 1 characters"

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary_title_length
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title of maximum allowed length (100 characters).
expected: The response payload contains the task with the exact title provided.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "X" * 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": max_length_title, "description": "Boundary test", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert response_data["title"] == max_length_title
assert response_data["description"] == "Boundary test"
assert response_data["completed"] is False
